processing_steps_notes.value: Sheets cold rolled to 30% thickness reduction after solution treatment; belongs to the low-to-medium reduction stage (10%–50%). Its microstructure is the Taylor-lattice-type low energy dislocation structure with refined slip bands (average slip band spacing ~231 nm).

source.reason: The sample identity is the 30% cold-rolled condition; text states the sheets were cold rolled to reductions of 10% to 90%, and b0024/b0031 report the 30% condition character.

overall_structure.value: Typical low energy dislocation structure (LEDS) of Taylor-lattice type resulting from planar dislocation glide (stage I, 10%–50% rolling reduction); composed of multiple interacting slip bands whose spacing gradually refines. Microstructure is essentially austenite with uniformly distributed nano-sized κ'-carbides; grains remain roughly equiaxed.

source.reason: b0023 describes stage I (10%–50%) as the Taylor-lattice-type LEDS from planar glide; b0024 gives the multiple-slip-band Taylor lattice, slip band spacing (30% = 231 nm) and Fig. 4(b) TEM for the 30% condition; Fig. 3(b) optical micrograph shows denser slip bands at 30%; Fig. 2/b0022 provides the retained austenite + κ'-carbide constituent.
